title: Have an approved private native forestry plan
what: Carry out private native forestry only under an approved private native forestry plan, which authorises the clearing; otherwise the clearing is unauthorised clearing of native vegetation (s 60N).

sources.title: Local Land Services Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Forestry operations are authorised by this Part if they are forestry operations to which a private native forestry plan applies

sources.title: Local Land Services Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Section 60N provides that it is a defence to the offence of clearing native vegetation in a rural area of the State under that section if (among other things) the clearing comprises forestry operations authorised under this Part
